answer: Because the whisper count is verified against the relic text itself, the zenith audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 32 aliases hence means producing 32 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
